title: Fiend Hunter Assistant
subtitle: Solo Very Hard automation
hint: Start from the Fiend Hunter lobby, or resume the same solo setup.
ready: Ready. Automatically attack, defend and heal; stop after the round is settled.
paused: Automation paused. The game remains running.

error: Action could not finish. See diagnostics for details.
timeout: Timed out waiting for the game page. Check the game prompt, then retry.
entry: Open the Fiend Hunter lobby, solo preparation screen, or the same active solo setup.
unsupported: Currently supports Blade against solo Very Hard Berserker. Please use this setup.
duplicate: The assistant is already open. Check the taskbar.
free: Free and open source · MadestSamurai · Bilibili MadSamurai
risk: Unofficial tool. Account penalties or game errors are possible. Use at your own risk.
permission: Cannot access the game. Run the tool and game with matching permissions.
adapt-error: Cannot reliably adapt to this client. See diagnostics and check for an update.
